Sample Question
SSC Examination
English-Paper Two
Total Marks: 100
Time: 3 hours

[Answer all the questions. Figures in the margin indicate full marks]

**Part A: Grammar**

1. Fill in the blanks with the words from the box. You may need to change the forms of some of the words. You may need to use one word more than once. $\frac{1}{2} \times 10 = 5$

| consume | die | for | an | of | on | the | by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Obesity is a medical condition caused (a) $\text{\_\_}$ excess body fat. The increase of body fat has an effect (b) $\text{\_\_}$ human health. Obesity increases (c) $\text{\_\_}$ likelihood of various diseases, particularly heart disease, diabetes, certain types of cancer etc. Obesity most commonly occurs due to a combination (d) $\text{\_\_}$ excessive dietary calories, lack of physical activity, and genetic factors. The primary treatment (e) $\text{\_\_}$ obesity is dieting and physical exercise. To supplement this, anti-obesity drugs may be taken to reduce appetite or reduce fat (f) $\text{\_\_}$. In severe cases, surgery is performed to reduce stomach volume or bowel length. Obesity is a leading preventable cause of (g) $\text{\_\_}$ worldwide. Authorities view it as one of the most serious public health problems of (h) $\text{\_\_}$ 21st century. Obesity is considered as (i) $\text{\_\_}$ illness in much of the modern world though it was once widely perceived as (j) $\text{\_\_}$ symbol of wealth and fertility.

2. Fill in the blanks with suitable words. $\frac{1}{2} \times 10 = 5$

The development of a nation is not (a) $\text{\_\_}$ easy task. It depends (b) $\text{\_\_}$ the willingness and sacrificing attitude of the valiant sons and daughters of (c) $\text{\_\_}$ soil. They don't work for any appreciation or reward (d) $\text{\_\_}$ themselves. Their vision is to (e) $\text{\_\_}$ the world a better place to live (f) $\text{\_\_}$.
